body:
These are essentially all but the same control. I’d suggest combining and deleting one of them. The single centralized aspect is in V1, so don’t bother mentioning that. 

“Verify that the application enforces access control rules on a trusted service layer, including where client-side access control is present, and thus could be bypassed.”

Or something pretty similar.
title: 4.1.1 De-dupe with 4.1.2?
